pricing: Free tier (tracking, library, social, Health) + Caliber Plus $12/mo or $72/yr (plans library, Strength Score, custom exercises, supersets, swaps, plate math, auto rest timer, photos, nutrition targets; 7-day trial) + Supporter $3/mo + Pro group coaching $19/mo + Premium 1-on-1 coaching from $200/mo
platforms: iPhone (iOS 15.1+, runs on Apple-silicon Mac), Android; no Apple Watch, no iPad-native, no web
positioning: Coaching company's strength-training tracker: solid free logger plus proprietary Strength Score, upsold to Plus and human 1-on-1 coaching; no AI in-app by design.

features.how: Track tab: per set reps OR time plus weight (exercise type rep- or time-based). Dumbbell = weight of one dumbbell, barbell = total incl. bar. Field order Weight-before-Reps configurable (default for new users since 5.4). Cardio is a separate activity type (time, distance, calories, pace).

Only 'smart warm-up' sets, generated per exercise from the target weight (added/removed in exercise edit). Logging drop sets and tagging own sets as warm-up are open requests ('Under Consideration', 248 and 161 votes). No failure tag.
No per-set RPE: 'RPE for sets' is on the board as Planned (182 votes). Only a post-workout rating slider + note per workout.

Under each set field the last logged value from the most recent session of that exercise is shown (e.g. 'Last: 95 lbs'); exercise History tab (also on the warm-up screen) shows past sessions and PR dates.

Fields are not pre-filled automatically; tapping the 'Last' text or the custom keyboard's 'Last' button (5.4) copies previous weight/reps/time into the field. Default exercise targets (sets/reps/time/rest) apply to exercises without own targets.
features.user_feedback: 'having to constantly edit and add weights instead of it having a baseline button that fills in last workouts numbers' - https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/page=2/id=1482405410/sortby=mostrecent/json

features.how: Exercise notes tab next to Track (enlarged in 5.12), optional workout note + rating at completion (all users since 4.2), custom workout instructions on templates; Premium: cardio notes to coach.

Supersets created/edited in a bottom sheet on the workout screen (5.3); auto rest timer is triggered between superset exercises; keyboard 'Next Set' jumps to next exercise in the superset. Listed as Plus feature on App Store. Substituting inside supersets is 'In Progress'.
Long-press an exercise on the Workout Overview screen to drag-reorder (4.2), incl. reordering within a superset; templates reordered in Plans via reorder icon.

Substitute from active workout or template; substitution list pre-filtered by primary muscle group (3.0.4) and since 5.14 ranked by exercise popularity. On finishing, user is asked whether to save changes to the template. 'Swap exercises' listed as Plus.
features.user_feedback: 'Smart exercise substitutions' still Planned (1617 votes) - https://feedback.caliberstrong.com/b/7vz226vy/feature-ideas/smart-exercise-substitutions

features.how: Barbell icon on Track screen: optimal plate configuration from target weight, bar weight (default 45 lb/20 kg, editable) and editable plate inventory; works for Barbell, Smith, Hammer Strength, Landmine, EZ and Trap bar; pre-loads last target (useful for warm-ups). 'Plate Math Calculator' is a Plus feature.
'Smart warmups' per exercise generate warm-up sets from working weight; adjustable target weight (±5 lb steps) on warm-up screen; history tab available there (3.1.19).
features.user_feedback: Request to allow 1-6 warm-up sets instead of fixed 3-4 (Planned) - https://feedback.caliberstrong.com/b/7vz226vy/feature-ideas/custom-number-of-warm-up-sets

features.how: For full-bodyweight lifts (pull-up, chin-up, dips, muscle-up...) latest logged bodyweight is added automatically - user logs only added weight; for assisted exercises assistance is subtracted from bodyweight. Applied to PRs, Strength Score and (since 5.13) charts.
No per-side logging documented.
No tempo field documented.

Workouts are started from a plan template via red + > Strength; ad-hoc additions to an active workout are possible (add exercises, update template prompt). No pure blank 'empty workout' flow documented.
features.user_feedback: 'I don't get why I can't just build a workout I want, then pull that one up and log it' - https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/page=3/id=1482405410/sortby=mostrecent/json

features.how: Select a past date on dashboard/calendar + red + to record a previous workout; completed workouts editable via View/Edit; editing a workout's date was released (2025).

Custom keyboard (5.4) with context button (Next field / Complete exercise / Next Set in superset / Update) and 'Last' button; rest timer, add set and complete buttons tappable with keyboard open (5.1).
features.user_feedback: 'constantly accidentally ending my workout' - https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/page=2/id=1482405410/sortby=mostrecent/json; 'Are you sure? when clicking complete workout' is Planned (286 votes) - https://feedback.caliberstrong.com/b/7vz226vy/feature-ideas/are-you-sure-when-clicking-complete-workout

features.how: Optional automatic rest timer (5.4, Plus/Premium): starts when reps/time of a completed set are entered; uses exercise rest target or default; deliberately NOT triggered between exercises (except supersets). Otherwise single tap starts timer with the exercise's rest target; long-press for other durations.
features.user_feedback: 'The rest timer is possessed... works half the time despite the global and per-exercise auto-timer setting being on' - https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/page=3/id=1482405410/sortby=mostrecent/json

features.how: Rest target per exercise, to the second since 5.4 (previously 1-min steps), plus global default rest.

Since 3.1.4 the rest timer dings when backgrounded on iOS; push notifications recommended for timer. Board idea 'Have timer ding when outside of the app' still Planned (681 votes). Timer resumes correctly after app reopen (5.1 fix).
No Live Activity / Dynamic Island; request 'Make Rest Timer A Live Activity' is Planned (86 votes).
Stopwatch next to the rest timer (3.1.6), can run concurrently; time-based exercises have target times.
Duration shown on workout completion summary (since 3.1.22). Estimated workout duration before start is Planned (533 votes).
No documented auto-finish/recovery of forgotten sessions.
features.user_feedback: 'it aborted my workout on the 23rd of 24 sets. No saved state upon restart' - https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/page=3/id=1482405410/sortby=mostrecent/json

features.how: Workout plans contain multiple workouts; create from scratch (choose number of workouts), via Workout Wizard, from Library or Pro; duplicate workouts and whole plans (5.7); bulk-edit exercise parameters across a workout (3.1.13).
No folders; multiple plans ('workout groups') act as containers with one default plan.

Workout Library (Plus): 120+ coach-designed plans with filters (duration, frequency, equipment...), coach bio, editable after adding; 28 new 45-min plans in 5.7; mobility workouts addable to plans; pregnancy/postpartum plans. Pro: new 4-week plans monthly.
No %1RM, block or deload programming in the app; FAQ: 'Do my workouts change automatically each week? No.' Periodization only via human coach (Premium) or monthly Pro plans.
Workout Wizard: answer questions (goal, experience, equipment incl. 'No Equipment', schedule) to generate a plan. Not AI; company states it has not used AI in-app.
features.user_feedback: 'changing your goals when you sign up ... doesn't change any of the workout plans the wizard comes up with' - https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/page=3/id=1482405410/sortby=mostrecent/json

features.how: Select a future date + red + to schedule a workout; calendar with month view and unlimited history. Recurring scheduling not available yet (Planned, 1004 votes); coaches can set recurring for Premium clients.
Share workouts/plans via link, inside groups or QR code (3.1.0); custom exercises travel with the shared workout. Sharing custom workouts listed as Plus feature.
800+ exercises per App Store ('almost 800' Sep 2026); regular additions (e.g. Hyrox exercises in 5.15).
features.user_feedback: 'Very bad selection of exercises. Lots of standard machines not even on there' - https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/page=1/id=1482405410/sortby=mostrecent/json

features.how: Looping demo videos + text instructions and coach tips; multi-step video tutorials for complex lifts; autoplay can be disabled; viewed videos cached for offline.
features.user_feedback: Some form videos contradict the text (e.g. bird dog, push-up) - https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/page=1/id=1482405410/sortby=mostrecent/json

features.how: Custom exercises (3.1.18) with name, muscle groups, equipment, rep- or time-based; private to user; deleting one deletes its history. Listed as Plus on App Store.
features.user_feedback: Request for photos/thumbnails on custom exercises - https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/page=3/id=1482405410/sortby=mostrecent/json

features.how: Primary/secondary muscles per exercise; 'Muscles Involved' at workout level updates live; tappable muscle groups list exercises targeting them (5.2.2).
Equipment filters combinable with muscle-group and Type (Strength/Mobility) filters.
Incremental search; since 5.14 results and filters ranked by exercise popularity (users completing it). Favorites are In Progress; semantic/alias search planned.
features.user_feedback: 'if I don't know the specific wording that the app uses, the exercise doesn't come up' - https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/page=3/id=1482405410/sortby=mostrecent/json

features.how: App and content English only.
No automatic weight/rep suggestions yet; 'Adaptive weight suggestions' In Progress (1122 votes) and 'guided progressions' announced as next backend work (Sep 2026).
No progression logic implemented (see prog_suggestions).
No fatigue/readiness model. Workaround: exclude a workout (e.g. deload, injury, travel) from Strength Score; 'Suggested workout changes' Under Consideration.
No recovery/fatigue or readiness model; sleep sync only Planned.
No in-app AI coach (deliberate). Instead human coaching (Pro group / Premium 1-on-1) and an MCP server so ChatGPT/Claude can read Caliber data (Menu > Connected Apps).

PR types: Estimated 1RM, Max Weight, Max Volume (set), Max Reps, Max Time. Realtime PR screen right after completing an exercise (5.12, can be disabled); PR dates on history; reset PRs per exercise or all (5.12.2) keeping history.
Estimated 1RM used for charts, PRs and Strength Score; sets >15 reps excluded from 1RM. Formula not published (help example: 200x8 = 250, 210x6 = 247).

Progress tab (5.13, free): customizable charts for exercises (e1RM, max weight, max set volume, max reps, max time), cardio, nutrition, body stats, habits; ranges 1 week-1 year, scroll back to account start; config persists.
Total workout volume (5.10) on summary/share cards/Strava. No weekly per-muscle volume; 'Additional workout stats' Planned (351 votes).
Per-workout 'Muscles Involved' and Strength Balance per muscle group; historical training heat map is Planned (571 votes).
Calendar with month view, dots per activity, unlimited history; Sunday/Monday week start (5.4). Streaks not shipped; coloured dots per workout Planned.
Completion screen with duration, rating, PR cards, total volume; shareable cards; viewable for past workouts from calendar.

Strength Score (Plus): relative-strength score 100-600 (Beginner...Elite) from e1RM per muscle group (legs, chest, back, shoulders, arms) x bodyweight multiplier, adjusted for age and sex, weighted by body mass; updated weekly (Sunday 3:00 EST). Strength Balance shows proportions across muscle groups. Bodyweight exercises (except weighted pull-ups/dips) and abs excluded. Can be hidden (5.4).
features.user_feedback: Divisive: users report score dropping despite progress (bodyweight gain, exercise-mix changes) and suspect upsell - https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/page=2/id=1482405410/sortby=mostrecent/json

features.how: Log bodyweight on Home or calendar (one entry/day); synced from Health/Health Connect smart scales; required for Strength Score.
Body stats limited to weight, body fat % and waist.
Progress photos (3 per entry), gallery (3.1.17), rebuilt with side-by-side comparison creator and sharing (5.14) for Plus/Premium.
No readiness/HRV; sleep sync Planned (53 votes).

Reads steps, cardio, nutrition (MyFitnessPal/FatSecret via Health), body stats; writes completed strength workouts to Health (3.1.22, toggle per workout). Android: Health Connect (4.1.3). Synced items not editable in Caliber.
No Apple Watch / Wear OS app; 'Apple Watch app' Planned (1182 votes). Watch data only via Apple Health.
Garmin activities only indirectly via Apple Health; direct Garmin integration Planned (683 votes). Cronometer direct OAuth integration; Strava (5.10).
No import from Strong/Hevy/CSV documented.
Menu > My Account > export: CSV of all workout + cardio data (date, exercise, sets, weight, reps, time) emailed to account address; max 1 per 24 h (5.7, Oct 2025).
Account-based cloud; offline mode saves locally and syncs when online (2.2.4, improved 4.2.2).
features.user_feedback: Account-loss complaints: 'reset your phone ... you will never get back all your data' - https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/page=3/id=1482405410/sortby=mostrecent/json

features.how: No iOS home-screen widget; request Under Consideration (207 votes).
No Siri/Shortcuts support documented.
No gym profiles; 'Granular exercise equipment selection' Under Consideration (557 votes).
Only plate inventory and bar weight for the plate calculator.
Equipment filter in exercise search and Library plan filters; Wizard asks equipment. No automatic availability filtering.

Circles (private, friends) and Communities (public topic groups) since 5.8 (Nov 2025); live workout status showing who is training and current exercise; PRs posted to circle; reactions, mentions, report.
features.user_feedback: GGR: community 'doesn't seem to be utilized a ton' - https://www.garagegymreviews.com/caliber-app-review

features.how: Share cards for workout summary, PRs, Strength Score/Balance, Track screen screenshots, progress photo comparisons; Strava auto-post.
Not documented.
Not documented; trophies/milestones Under Consideration.
In-house coaches only: Premium 1-on-1 (from $200/mo; users report $450/mo), coach has real-time access to workouts, cardio, body stats, nutrition, lessons; weekly review. Pro: $19/mo group coaching.
features.user_feedback: 'Great coach but meh app ... before you commit to $4500/year' - https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/page=1/id=1482405410/sortby=mostrecent/json

features.how: Coach programs the plan weekly (Premium); Pro gets monthly 4-week plans kept forever.
Video form review: long-press a set > Upload Form Video; sent to coach/Pro group after workout; backend processing rebuilt in 5.2.
features.user_feedback: BarBend: 'Uploading videos for form correction can be quite the hassle' - https://barbend.com/caliber-fitness-app-review/

features.how: In-app text/video messaging and live video calls; coach replies within hours; former clients keep read-only history.
Coaches are Caliber employees matched after consultation; no third-party marketplace.

Free: unlimited workouts tracking, exercise library, circles, Apple Health. Plus $12/mo or $72/yr (discounts $6-9/mo, $36-54/yr): Library plans, Strength Score/Balance, lessons, nutrition targets, custom exercises, supersets, swaps, plate math, auto rest timer, progress photos. Supporter $3/mo (no upsell pop-ups). Pro $19/mo; Premium from $200/mo, 30-day money-back.
features.user_feedback: Most 1-star reviews: ads say 'free' but onboarding ends in 7-day trial/paywall; cardio logging not free - https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/page=2/id=1482405410/sortby=mostrecent/json

features.how: Global units for distance, weight, length (set in registration); cannot switch lbs/kg during active workout; no per-exercise units.
Dark mode rolled out 5.0-5.7 (Dec 2024-Oct 2025); pure-black theme planned.
English only.
features.user_feedback: DD/MM/YYYY date format request Under Consideration - https://feedback.caliberstrong.com/b/7vz226vy/feature-ideas/ddmmyyyy-format

features.how: No declared App Store accessibility features; fixes for 'Reduce motion'/'Remove animations' breaking buttons.
Registration flow with goal/experience/equipment questions, birthday (needed for Strength Score), units; dismissible explanatory widgets; ends with generated plan + Plus paywall.
features.user_feedback: 'ridiculous that i have to answer 15+ questions, make an account' - https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/page=1/id=1482405410/sortby=mostrecent/json

features.how: Offline mode: start/track/save workouts, view dashboard/plans; cached videos only; other screens unavailable.
Account required (email); App Store: Health & Fitness, contact info, photos/videos, identifiers linked to identity. Account deletion in-app deletes all data.
Same methodology as Strength Score, shows balance across muscle groups to fix imbalances; tappable muscle-group trend 1/3/6 months.
Per-workout toggle 'Exclude from Strength Score' for deloads/injury/travel.
Official MCP server (Jul 2026) lets ChatGPT and Claude read Caliber training data; Menu > Connected Apps.
Auto-post strength workouts (exercises, sets, PR count, volume) to Strava; per-workout opt-out (5.10).
Nutrition from Cronometer (direct), MyFitnessPal/FatSecret (via Health/Google Fit); Nutrition Wizard sets calorie/macro targets shown vs actuals (Plus).
Cardio activities (incl. custom), steps, nutrition logged/synced as Home 'activities' and charted under Habits/Cardio.
Weekly expert lessons on training, nutrition, habits (Plus).
Global default sets/reps/time/rest for exercises without own targets (5.4).
Sunday/Monday week start; Strength metrics update aligned (5.4).
Public Frill board (ideas, votes, roadmap, detailed release notes by the founder) linked in-app.
Post-workout rating slider + note; history of ratings/notes per workout in Notes section.
